name: ass-tracker
description: ICT Asset Tracker — LAN-ready inventory for ICT teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client -- --host"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
